prologue.title: Prologue
prologue.p1: I'm Yaiza Muñoz, a Software Engineer with over eight years of experience in tech. I bridge code and design to create digital products that improve people's everyday lives.
prologue.p2: I work with design systems to ensure visual consistency and make every interaction clear and functional. I collaborate closely with developers, uniting design and technology so the final product respects every detail of the user experience.
prologue.p3: Outside the screen, I read, cook to unwind, knit, enjoy nature, and explore new forms of design. For me, good UX doesn't just organize interfaces: it makes life simpler, more human, and more meaningful for the people who use them.

projects.title: AURA
projects.longTitle: AURA: exercise and nutrition that adapt to your hormonal cycle
projects.epigraph: Your body changes. So does your energy.

left.title: Key points
items: Separate apps for cycle, nutrition and exercise: the user has to interpret isolated data.
An ecosystem where AI adapts workouts, meals and routines to the phase of the cycle.
Musa, Hormona, Dotsdays, YogaJoy and BitePal. None of them spans all three areas.
